Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was driving home along the main road when the car in front of me stopped suddenly, and I braked as hard as I
could. The vehicle coming the other way crossed into my lane, and we collided head-on. The impact was not very
fast, but it was enough to throw everyone in my car forward and back. My passengers and I all felt pain in our necks,
shoulders, and chests, and one of them hit their head on the window frame. We were shaken and could barely get out
of the vehicle. The accident happened on 23 Sep 2024 near Pearland, at about the time of evening rush hour, and
the road was wet. Paramedics came to the scene and took everyone to hospital for checks. I have kept copies of all
the medical reports and photographs I took at the scene.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
